queries.name: esquema_tablas_mapeo
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS tabla,
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS columna,
    ty.name AS tipo_sql,
    c.is_nullable
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE t.name IN (
    'Sistema_EmpresasServidores',
    'Producto_MapeoOrigen',
    'Unidades_Negocio',
    'Sistema_Empresas'
)
ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id

queries.name: empresas_servidores_registros
queries.sql:
SELECT
    EmpresaID,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CodigoSucursalSistema) AS codigos_sucursal,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NumeroSucursalSistema) AS numeros_sucursal
FROM dbo.Sistema_EmpresasServidores
GROUP BY EmpresaID
ORDER BY EmpresaID

queries.name: producto_mapeo_origen_muestra
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), ServerID) AS ServerID,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS registros_mapeo
FROM dbo.Producto_MapeoOrigen
GROUP BY ServerID
ORDER BY registros_mapeo DESC

queries.name: unidades_sucursal_origen
queries.sql:
SELECT
    codigo,
    nombre,
    CONVERT(varchar(36), id) AS unidad_guid,
    server_id,
    sucursal_origen_id,
    activo
FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio
ORDER BY codigo

queries.name: integridad_recetas_productos
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), r.ServerID) AS ServerID,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.ProductoID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS producto_no_encontrado
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
LEFT JOIN dbo.Sync_Productos p
    ON p.ProductoID = r.ProductoID
   AND p.ServerID = r.ServerID
GROUP BY r.ServerID
ORDER BY componentes DESC

queries.name: integridad_recetas_insumos
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), r.ServerID) AS ServerID,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes_con_insumo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.InsumoID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS insumo_no_encontrado
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
LEFT JOIN dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos i
    ON i.InsumoID = r.InsumoID
   AND i.ServerID = r.ServerID
WHERE r.InsumoID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.ServerID
ORDER BY componentes_con_insumo DESC

objective: Diagnosticar las relaciones existentes entre empresas, servidores, sucursales, productos, recetas e insumos. Determinar si es posible separar Origen y 130QRO. Exclusivamente lectura, sin cambios ni produccion.
